title: [Extensibility][SubscriptionBilling]: Make usage data billing filtering extensible in SetUsageDataBillingFilters
summary: Usage data billing filtering in Subscription Line now uses an open-ended filter instead of a bounded range, allowing custom enum values to be included, and adds an integration event to let partners adjust the filters.
key_points: Replaced bounded SetRange with SetFilter to include custom Usage Based Pricing enum values above the original maximum
Added OnAfterSetUsageDataBillingFilters integration event for extensibility
Behavior unchanged for existing shipped enum values (ordinals 1-3), None (ordinal 0) still excluded
Custom partner-added enum values (ordinal ≥4) now included instead of silently dropped
Low risk change with backward compatibility maintained
